purpose: Confirm the overhead effect of bypassing irrelevant TMCP packets at the persistent MCP server invocation boundary, excluding one-time launcher and interpreter startup.

tasks.objective: Plan a reusable skill that rotates a supplied PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees with a user-selected output path. Do not create or edit files; return only the clarified scope, reusable resources, initialization steps, and validation plan.
Translate the supplied note into French. Preserve the product name TMCP, version 0.5.7, command text `tmcp doctor`, and both bullet points. Do not add commentary.

benchmark.measurement: monotonic nanoseconds around _compose_packet in one persistent loaded server process
benchmark.outlier_policy: retain every successful measured pair; fail closed on any missing or unsuccessful observation

evidence_boundary: Confirmatory local persistent-server benchmark. It reuses digest-bound v0.4 blinded behavioral evidence, makes no model calls, excludes one-time process startup, and does not measure provider token usage or end-to-end agent latency.
